title: ContractScrub: A benchmark for final review of legal contracts
abstract: arXiv:2608.20204v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Legal work, with its heavy reliance on processing large amounts of text, is often considered one of the domains most exposed to the use of LLMs. Contract ``scrubbing,'' the final review of transactional agreements for errors and inconsistencies, is a particularly suitable task for automation, because it is routine, painstaking work requiring detailed attention to long documents. Scrubbing also seems to align naturally with the general capabilities expected of frontier LLMs around long-context reasoning, consistency checking, and named entity recognition (NER). Despite the economic value and potential for automation, no formal evaluations of LLMs performing contract scrubbing have been conducted. translated_title: ContractScrub：法律合同终审复核的基准测试
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.20204v1 公告类型：新 摘要：法律工作高度依赖处理大量文本，通常被视为最易受大型语言模型（LLM）应用影响的领域之一。合同“清洗”，即对交易协议进行最终复核以发现错误和不一致之处，是一项特别适合自动化的任务，因为它是一项常规、费力的工作，需要对长文档进行细致关注。清洗工作似乎也与前沿LLM在长上下文推理、一致性检查和命名实体识别（NER）方面的一般能力自然契合。尽管具有经济价值和自动化潜力，但目前尚无针对LLM执行合同清洗任务的正式评估。我们引入了ContractScrub，这是首个旨在评估合同清洗能力的基准测试，包含由经验丰富的律师手工制作的合同，覆盖多种错误类别，如定义术语误用、引用错误等。
tldr: 本文提出了首个针对法律合同终审复核（合同清洗）的基准测试ContractScrub，填补了LLM在该任务上缺乏正式评估的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ContractScrub, the first benchmark for evaluating LLM performance on legal contract scrubbing (final review), filling the gap of formal evaluation in this task.
